user.title: Connect to FamilieDosmer
user.description:
Enter your Personal Access Token from FamilieDosmer.

You can create a token under Min profil → API-adgangstokens in the FamilieDosmer app.

families.title: Select Families
families.description: Choose which families to integrate with Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate FamilieDosmer
reauth_confirm.description: Your API token has expired or is no longer valid. Enter a new token to restore access.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to FamilieDosmer. Please try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Verify your Personal Access Token.
error.at_least_one_family: Please select at least one family.

abort.reauth_successful: Reauthentication successful. FamilieDosmer is now connected.
